meta.model: H2190_exo_hip (Hyfydy, 90 muscles, 21 DOF incl. 6 root DOFs; models/H2190_exo_hip.hfd)

signs.pelvis_tilt: + = counterclockwise viewed from the right (pelvis front up, i.e. posterior tilt)
signs.exo: hip_flexion_*.input (DOF actuator, N-m), + = flexion torque. Set every 25 Hz control step and held; values here interpolate between control ticks as in plots/plot_torque_vs_speed_sim.py:84-91
signs.grf: vertical ground reaction force of that foot, body weights (>= 0)
signs.grf_fx: fore-aft GRF along the walking direction, body weights (+ = forward/propulsive)
signs.cop_x: center of pressure along the walking direction, m, same x frame as pelvis_tx; null = no contact (vertical GRF <= 1 N). At a contact edge the 100 Hz log holds COP = 0,0,0 on the unloaded sample, so there the loaded neighbouring sample's COP is used instead of interpolating.
signs.act: muscle activation x 100 (state after first-order activation dynamics), 0..100

meta.fk: Units: meters, radians. Frame: x = forward (walking direction), y = up, ground at y = 0; viewed from the model's RIGHT side (x to the right of the screen), so positive angles are counterclockwise on screen. R(a) = [[cos a, -sin a], [sin a, cos a]]. Every body frame's origin is that body's COM (Hyfydy). 1) pelvis: origin O = (q.pelvis_tx, q.pelvis_ty), angle A = q.pelvis_tilt. 2) for each other body b in the order of 'bodies' (parents come first): with parent origin Op and angle Ap, joint J = Op + R(Ap) * b.joint_in_parent; A_b = Ap + q[b.dof]; O_b = J - R(A_b) * b.joint_in_child. dof: femur_* = hip_flexion_* (+ = flexion, thigh swings forward), tibia_* = knee_angle_* (NEGATIVE = flexion, shank swings back), calcn_* = ankle_angle_* (+ = dorsiflexion, toes up), torso = lumbar_extension (+ = extension, trunk leans back). 3) a point p given in body b (muscle path point, segment point, circle center) is at O_b + R(A_b) * p. Canvas: sx = cx + s*(x - camera_x), sy = cy - s*y (flip y). Treadmill view: camera_x = q.pelvis_tx + cycle_index * stride_length_m (pelvis_tx restarts at 0 each cycle), i.e. on average stride_speed_mps * t; scroll the ground with that, not with speed_mps (a few % lower, see speed_note), or the stance foot slides. Left and right legs share the same sagittal-plane coordinates (the planar model drops the 0.0835 m lateral hip offset); draw the left (far) leg first/dimmer. Exo torque acts on the hip DOF: + = flexion torque on the thigh (and the reaction on the pelvis). Use q (display values from a 2D IK fit, see q_note) for drawing; q_dof holds the logged DOFs.
meta.speed_note: label/speed_mps = mean pelvis_tx_u over window_s, the "rollout pelvis speed" that plots/plot_torque_vs_speed_sim.py:90 prints for the same SIM_WINDOWS (:29); the other sim data on this page use the same values. pelvis_tx_u is the pelvis COM velocity along the pelvis's own forward axis (checked: world COM velocity rotated into the pelvis frame, RMS difference 0), so with the pelvis tilted it reads 1.4-3.1% below travel_speed_mps = horizontal pelvis-COM displacement over window_s / elapsed time (the model walks along world -z). stride_speed_mps = stride_length_m / duration_s of the drawn stride. nominal_mps = treadmill speed of the reference clip segment (plots/plot_torque_vs_speed_sim.py:29); speed_mps is -5%, -9%, -9%, -8%, +2% relative to nominal.
meta.drawing: segments_to_draw: bones in body-local coordinates. Femur/tibia = joint-center lines from the .hfd. Foot outline = ankle joint, heel/toe contact spheres, toes origin (0.0788, -0.032; bofoot mesh offset) and ext_dig distal points (approximate). Pelvis outline joins muscle attachment landmarks (sartorius origin ~ ASIS, iliac crest via int_obl/quad_lumb/erec_sp origins, glut_max3 origin ~ sacrum, hamstring origin ~ ischial tuberosity, add_long origin ~ pubis, rect_fem origin ~ AIIS); approximate. trunk_circles = torso/pelvis contact capsules seen end-on (circles); leg_capsules = leg contact capsules (axis along body y). spine = trunk centerline from the lumbar joint through the torso contact capsule centers to the head sphere center. No arms: the torso body includes head, arms and trunk.
meta.source: Deterministic rollout of the healthy_exo_hip policy (739.2M steps) on reference clip 11_normal_walk, 100 Hz SCONE log, one stride per speed window starting at right heel strike.

bodies.note: root body: origin at (pelvis_tx, pelvis_ty), angle pelvis_tilt
